items.difficulty_reason: The counted corollary is the author corollary at source lines 2523-2526: if Gamma is satisfiable then it is consistent. The author proof (2528-2537) is a complete contrapositive: inconsistency yields a finite B_1,...,B_n in Gamma and a closed tableau for {True B_1,...,True B_n}; the unit's tableau soundness theorem (cited by label) gives no structure satisfying all the B_i; hence Gamma is unsatisfiable. Nothing is omitted.
